sources.scope: Spanish INE surname statistics for residents; official statistical reference.
Historical INE-derived Spanish first-surname CSV (2012 repository). Uppercase converted for display; some source accents are missing and have not been reconstructed. Reuse terms require review.

2,500 next highest eligible names from historical INE-derived Spanish first-surname counts in pinned 2012 CSV. Never concatenate paternal/maternal surnames or invent missing accents. Dataset is historical and reuse terms require review.
